This binary has no UI embedded.

You are talking to a natively built dbonlinetest-server. It serves /api correctly, but the React app was not compiled into it — this placeholder is what //go:embed all:web/dist found in the source tree.

That is the expected shape of the development workflow: run make dev and open the Vite dev server instead, which proxies /api here.

For the deployed shape — one container, UI and API on one port — build the image: make up (docker compose up --build -d). The image build writes the real Vite output over this file before compiling.
